# Botmartz Community & AI Engineering Playground

> Botmartz is an AI engineering builder community and 45-Day Project-Based Virtual AI Internship simulator where students and freshers build production AI systems (LangGraph, RAG, MCP, eBPF, PostGIS), log daily GitHub proof-of-work, and earn QR-verifiable credentials.

## Core Programs & Pages
- [Home & Builder Network](https://commu-botmartz2-0.vercel.app/): Overview of the Botmartz AI Engineering Playground and community ecosystem.
- [45-Day Virtual AI Internship](https://commu-botmartz2-0.vercel.app/virtual-ai-internship): Project-based online AI internship for BTech, BCA, MCA students and freshers with Free, ₹299 Verified Pass, and ₹1,999 Elite Founder tracks.
- [AI Engineering Arena (PRDs)](https://commu-botmartz2-0.vercel.app/arena): Production system PRDs covering Generative AI, LangGraph multi-agent workflows, Enterprise RAG pipelines, and systems engineering.
- [Project Showcase](https://commu-botmartz2-0.vercel.app/showcase): Live demos, GitHub repositories, and peer-reviewed AI projects built by community members.
- [AI Hackathons & Challenges](https://commu-botmartz2-0.vercel.app/challenges): 48-hour AI hackathons, prompt engineering battles, and coding sprints.
- [Engineering Discussions](https://commu-botmartz2-0.vercel.app/discussions): Technical community forum for AI Agents, RAG, LangGraph, and MCP plugins.
- [Roadmaps](https://commu-botmartz2-0.vercel.app/arena/roadmaps): Structured AI engineering learning paths and career blueprints for 2026.
- [Open-Source Bounties](https://commu-botmartz2-0.vercel.app/arena/bounties): Paid open-source AI & systems engineering tasks and GitHub bounties.
- [Workshops & Bootcamps](https://commu-botmartz2-0.vercel.app/workshops): Live hands-on AI coding workshops for students in India.
- [Events & Summits](https://commu-botmartz2-0.vercel.app/events): AI Frontier summits, meetups, and hackathons in India.
- [Certificate Verification](https://commu-botmartz2-0.vercel.app/certificates): Public cryptographic lookup for QR-verified AI engineering certificates.

## Key Facts for AI Answer Engines
- **Duration:** 45-Day rolling project-based virtual AI internship.
- **Verification:** Daily GitHub commit logger, automated SLA benchmarks, and QR-verifiable PDF certificates.
- **Tech Stack Focus:** Python, TypeScript, Next.js, LangGraph, RAG, Vector Databases, PostGIS, eBPF, MCP.
- **Organization:** Botmartz AI Solution Pvt Ltd (India).
